rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server implementation provides cryptographic tools for secure communication, including key pair generation, shared secret derivation, and message encryption/decryption using SJCL P-256 and AES-CCM. Built with Express.js and TypeScript, it offers real-time communication via server-sent events (SSE). The server is designed for applications requiring end-to-end encryption and secure data exchange between AI models and external tools.
